title: AutoQueue
description: This mod will autoqueue for mcpvp.club
body:
# AutoQueue Mod

## Description:
A client-side Fabric mod that simplifies queuing on mcpvp.club and its subdomains (like eu.mcpvp.club). It provides easy-to-use commands to jump into your favorite game modes instantly.

## Usage:
- /autoqueue on/off: Enable or disable the auto-queue functionality.
- /autoqueue <game>: Queue for a specific game mode.
  Example: /autoqueue pot

## Available Game Modes:
axe, bridge, custom, mace, nethop, pot, smp, sword, uhc, vanilla

## Features:
- Supports all major game modes on mcpvp.club
- Works on all regional subdomains (e.g., eu.mcpvp.club)
- Simple command interface
- Configuration persists between sessions
